7-digit CUIN plus date of incorporation.

Required for sole proprietors and unregistered AOPs.
Date transport operations began.
Own-fleet operator / Fleet aggregator (attached vehicles) / Freight broker / Contract carrier.

fields.field: Goods carriage permit / transport licence number
fields.validation: Permit number issued by the Provincial Transport Authority.

Full address including city, province and postal code.

fields.validation: Determines the provincial revenue authority and default operating base.
MULTIPLE SUPPORTED - one row per depot: address, city, parking capacity (vehicles), yard in-charge and mobile.
Official mailbox; receives dispatch instructions and freight bills.
Format +92-XX-XXXXXXXX or +92-3XX-XXXXXXX; must be reachable outside office hours.
7 digits + '-' + check digit; unique per transporter record.
Required where the transporter is registered for sales tax on goods.
Filer / Non-filer - drives the withholding tax rate on freight payments (Sec. 153 transport services).

fields.field: Filer status - date last verified against ATL
fields.validation: Date the status in 2.3 was checked on the FBR Active Taxpayer List.

fields.field: Filer status - valid until (next verification due)
fields.validation: EDITABLE / UPDATED PERIODICALLY. On expiry the ERP applies non-filer rates until re-verified.
Monthly / Quarterly / Half-yearly - the system raises an alert on the due date.

fields.field: Provincial sales tax on services authority & registration no.
fields.validation: SRB / PRA / KPRA / BRA - transport services are taxable at the provincial level.

fields.field: Provincial sales tax rate applied on freight
fields.validation: Rate applicable to goods transport services in the province of supply.
Applied automatically based on the filer status in field 2.3.
Certificate issued by the Commissioner Inland Revenue, if claimed.
Start date of the exemption period.
DATE FIELD - amber 30 days before expiry, red once expired.
Active while valid. INACTIVE BY DEFAULT after expiry - the ERP resumes the normal withholding rate automatically.
FBR digital invoicing (integrated) / Manual bill - determines e-invoice handling of freight bills.
Finance officer who verified the NTN, provincial registration and ATL status.

fields.validation: Exactly one account must be flagged as primary.
Online transfer / Cheque / Pay order, and the settlement cycle (per trip, weekly, fortnightly).

fields.field: Security deposit / bank guarantee - instrument, bank & amount
fields.validation: Instrument type, issuing bank and amount held against goods in transit.

fields.field: Security deposit / bank guarantee - valid until
fields.validation: DATE FIELD - amber 30 days before expiry, red once expired. On expiry the instrument is treated as nil until replaced.
Maximum advance the transporter may hold against future trips.

fields.field: Bank details verified by finance team
fields.validation: Dual verification required before the account is activated.

fields.field: Certificate of Incorporation / Form II / registration proof

fields.validation: Both sides; one file per owner or partner.

fields.validation: One per bank account listed in Section 4.
